rows.Title: Chasing late payments is manual and awkward
rows.Description: Getting paid takes more effort than sending the invoice. Customers chase by email, phone, sticky notes or red cells, and the chasing feels awkward with clients they want to keep.
Quotes: "Sending them is fine now. Getting paid is the problem. I spend every Friday morning chasing late invoices by email." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"I have a sticky note on my screen with the names of clients to chase. That should not be my system." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"When a publisher is late I wait two more weeks before I dare to write, because I do not want to look desperate." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`

rows.Title: Paying full seats for people who only view
rows.Description: Teams grow, but only a few people send invoices. Paying a full seat for someone who only looks at numbers feels wrong and pushes customers to look elsewhere.
Quotes: "Our old tool charged per seat. We are six people, and only two of us ever send an invoice, but we paid for six." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"The rest only need to see the numbers. Paying a full seat for someone who reads a dashboard feels wrong." — Jonas Weber · Brightline · 2026-09-22 · call `2026-09-22_brightline`
"We hired two juniors who only need to see the invoice status. I do not want to pay full seats for them." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-10-20 · call `2026-10-20_northwind-studio`

rows.Title: Payment reminders must sound like the sender, not a robot
rows.Description: One cold template for every client damages relationships, so customers switch reminders off. Reminders written per client, in their own voice, get used.
Quotes: "I turned it off. It sends the same cold text to everyone. A client of five years got the same message as a one-off job." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-09-02 · call `2026-09-02_northwind-studio`
"If it sounds like a collection agency, the art director will think I am difficult." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"I can now write one template for regulars and one for slow payers." — Dana Holt · Northwind Studio · 2026-10-20 · call `2026-10-20_northwind-studio`

rows.Title: No guidance on what VAT to put on cross-border invoices
rows.Description: Freelancers with clients in other countries do not know whether to add VAT or what sentence the invoice needs, and look it up every time.
Quotes: "Half my clients are in the UK. I never know if I should add VAT or not, and the app does not tell me." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"It has a field for the VAT number, but it does not tell me what to write." — Tomas Lind · Tomas Lind · 2026-10-27 · call `2026-10-27_tomas-lind`

rows.Title: Client import fails on real spreadsheets
rows.Description: The importer expects one address format and one column order. Customers give up, type clients in by hand, or keep two systems.
Quotes: "The import was painful. We had four hundred clients in a spreadsheet and the importer rejected half of them because of the address format." — Ravi Shah · Pixel & Pine · 2026-09-09 · call `2026-09-09_pixel-pine`
"Let me match the columns myself. Show me my sheet and ask which column is the email." — Leo Marchetti · Leo Marchetti · 2026-10-01 · call `2026-10-01_leo-marchetti`

rows.Title: Would pay more, or drop the old system, for chasing done for them
rows.Description: Automatic chasing is the feature customers attach money or a full switch to.
Quotes: "I would pay more if it chased people for me, honestly." — Hana Okafor · Hana Okafor · 2026-09-15 · call `2026-09-15_hana-okafor`
"If the app knew who was late and nudged them, I would close the sheet for good." — Leo Marchetti · Leo Marchetti · 2026-10-01 · call `2026-10-01_leo-marchetti`
